about: OpenMeet reading detector: is this person reading? 10 s gaze windows at 10 fps, GazeBase degraded to webcam quality.

protocol.split: 258 development / 64 test people (protocol.split_people, seed 2026); test people scored once
protocol.selection: highest mean development window balanced accuracy over the four conditions; thresholds from development nominal scores
protocol.thresholds: balanced = best development balanced accuracy; low_fpr = at most 5% of development non-reading flagged
protocol.recording: recording score = mean of its top half of window scores
